content: tokenVersion revocation (jsonic.io 2026-05-23, easyjwt 2025-07-10): User.tokenVersion Int @default(0); embed claim at issue; verify: signature check then load user select tokenVersion and compare; mismatch -> 401; increment on password change / logout-all via { tokenVersion: { increment: 1 } }; cost = 1 DB read per request, cacheable with short TTL; blunt instrument (revokes all sessions per user)
